# dydemo - throughput, latency & errors

The `gateway` and `backend` services in namespace **`dydemo`** (sample-flask-app), scoped by `k8s.namespace.name == "dydemo"`. OneAgent app-only injection, no OTel SDK.

| Path | Expected signal |
|---|---|
| `GET /` | 200 baseline |
| `GET /client_error` | always **400** - counts as a 4xx response, *not* a failure |
| `GET /server_error` | always **500** - counts as a failure |
| `GET /latency` | 200 with a p90=2s / p99=5s **tail** |
| `GET /blowup` | 200, but 30% `sys.exit(1)` - worker death |
| `GET /transaction` | 201 via `backend`; **504** on timeout, **502** when unreachable |
| `POST /` | the `backend` service, called by `/transaction` |

> **Why `Failure rate %` can read 0% while 400s are flowing:** Dynatrace counts only server-side failures (5xx, crashes) in `dt.service.request.failure_count`. Client errors are tracked separately - see the **4xx responses** tile and the status-code charts.

1.title: Requests

2.title: Failure rate % (5xx / crashes)

3.title: 4xx responses

4.title: p95 latency (ms)

5.title: p99 latency (ms)

7.title: Requests/min by endpoint (all paths)
7.query: timeseries reqs = sum(dt.service.request.count), by:{endpoint.name}, filter: { k8s.namespace.name == "dydemo" }

8.title: Requests/min by HTTP status code
8.query: timeseries reqs = sum(dt.service.request.count), by:{http.response.status_code}, filter: { k8s.namespace.name == "dydemo" }

9.content: ## Latency - watch p50 stay flat while p90/p99 jump; that's `/latency`'s deliberate tail, not uniform slowness

10.title: Latency percentiles (ms)

11.title: p95 latency by endpoint (ms)

12.content: ## Errors - 400 from `/client_error`, 500 from `/server_error`, 502/504 from `/transaction` when the backend times out or is unreachable

13.title: Error responses/min by status code (>= 400)
13.query: timeseries errs = sum(dt.service.request.count), by:{http.response.status_code}, filter: { k8s.namespace.name == "dydemo" and http.response.status_code >= 400 }

14.title: Error total by status code and endpoint
14.query:
timeseries errs = sum(dt.service.request.count), by:{http.response.status_code, endpoint.name}, filter: { k8s.namespace.name == "dydemo" and http.response.status_code >= 400 }
| fieldsAdd errors = arraySum(errs)
| fields http.response.status_code, endpoint.name, errors
| sort errors desc

15.content: ## Per-endpoint detail - every path across both services, with throughput, failure rate and latency percentiles side by side

16.title: Endpoint breakdown (gateway + backend)
16.query:
timeseries { reqs = sum(dt.service.request.count), fails = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count), p50 = percentile(dt.service.request.response_time, 50), p95 = percentile(dt.service.request.response_time, 95), p99 = percentile(dt.service.request.response_time, 99) }, by:{dt.service.name, endpoint.name}, filter: { k8s.namespace.name == "dydemo" }
| fieldsAdd requests = arraySum(reqs), failures = arraySum(fails), p50_ms = arrayAvg(p50) / 1000, p95_ms = arrayAvg(p95) / 1000, p99_ms = arrayAvg(p99) / 1000
| fieldsAdd error_rate_pct = (failures * 100.0) / requests
| fields dt.service.name, endpoint.name, requests, failures, error_rate_pct, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms
| sort requests desc

17.content: ## Crash & cross-service - `/blowup` worker death, and the `/transaction` -> `backend` hop

18.title: /blowup - requests vs failures (worker crashes)
18.query: timeseries { reqs = sum(dt.service.request.count), fails = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count) }, by:{endpoint.name}, filter: { k8s.namespace.name == "dydemo" and contains(endpoint.name, "/blowup") }

19.title: /transaction + backend - requests vs failures
19.query: timeseries { reqs = sum(dt.service.request.count), fails = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count) }, by:{dt.service.name, endpoint.name}, filter: { k8s.namespace.name == "dydemo" and (contains(endpoint.name, "/transaction") or dt.service.name == "backend") }
